title: Snazzie FM News: The Vitals Desk
description: The Vitals Desk reads the top of the hour: a recertified ninety-year soup, a record night at HonkHeal, and a roving blood drive nobody can find.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. The Vitals Desk on Snazzie F M. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our top story, good news on the wellness front.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: County Health has recertified the ninety-year soup as a living wellness asset. It now counts as a vegetable.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Officials add one condition, Dale. You are not to look directly into it.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Sound advice. Marsha, the urgent care numbers.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: HonkHeal urgent care reports a record night. Eleven patients fully cured.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: They were all honked at, at once. None consented. HonkHeal calls it a clean sweep.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Still developing, the municipal blood drive nobody can find. The van keeps relocating. It is now reportedly parked inside the fog, accepting donations for the city.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And the fog has now filed to become an organ donor.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: It has no organs. <p:0.3> Officials confirm it is donating yours.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: The desk reminds you that participation is mandatory and deeply appreciated.
